verified_behaviors: share creation requires REVIEWER project role and a verified successful artifact
raw tokens are 128-bit URL-safe random values and are returned only once
only SHA-256 token hashes are stored
unknown, expired, revoked and exhausted tokens return the same 404
expiry and revocation take effect immediately because shares are not cached
maximum accesses are enforced atomically under concurrent requests
anonymous report responses set no-store, no-referrer and nosniff headers
share creation and revocation are audited; access count and last access time are recorded
limitations: There is no separate short-domain redirect service; the link path is short but uses the API host
Access statistics are aggregate count and last access time, not per-visitor analytics
Hot-link capacity, negative-cache behavior and multi-instance acceptance pending
Per-tenant share quotas and dedicated share rate-limit buckets pending
